name: Code Developer Agent
description: Autonomous agent that can read, analyze, and write code to accomplish development tasks

inputs.name: Task Description
inputs.description: Description of the development task to accomplish

inputs.name: Working Directory
inputs.description: The root directory of the project to work on

inputs.name: Additional Context
inputs.description: Additional context or requirements for the task

outputs.name: Files Modified
outputs.description: List of files that were created or modified

outputs.name: Status
outputs.description: Status of the task: completed, partial, failed
